title: 第7章 借势脱身
slug: 江南第一媳全本免费-江南第一媳最新章节列表
content_zh:
梁心铭确实无话可说，对这等审案方式无语到了极点。但她却没有露出嘲笑的神情。黄县令愚昧不要紧，轻者会断送她的前程，重者断送她的性命。官场上这类事并不少见，万万大意不得。她强迫自己冷静，思索脱身之法。
无论如何，今天晚上她一定要离开县衙，按时参加明天最后一场考试，不然的话，她之前的努力就白费了。
她提醒道：“大人，把这衣裳套在别的女人身上，或者其他俊俏的少年身上，同样会达到这个效果。”
黄县令一愣，随即喝道：“胡说！别的女人认识豆腐西施吗？谁会为了她杀人？别的俊俏少年谁会那么巧的在那个时辰路过河边？就算他路过了，与豆腐西施有关吗？”
梁心铭也一愣，没想到他还不算昏聩，没到无可救药的程度，这几句话说的挺有道理，情形对她更不利了。
她道：“大人，学生早晨是从渔梁街经过。那巷子是东西走向，学生若要进去，必须从渔梁街进巷。而这小厮是守在巷子东头的，学生若是进去，他怎会没发现？学生杀了人后，又是如何出来的呢？”
这些问题不弄明白，如何定他的罪！
黄县令道：“所以说你做得高明啊！本官也不得不佩服。你到底是如何作案的，还不从实招来！”
他给予梁心铭高度评价。
梁心铭也像惠娘一般感到无语。她机敏果断更胜过惠娘，当即决定放弃和黄县令辩论，因为那纯属浪费口舌。若再激怒了黄县令，一怒之下将她关进牢房，那时，她即便有满腹的机智也使出不来，要如何自救？
她便正色道：“大人，学生是来参加乡试的，明天还要下场。这案子扑朔迷离，还是等学生考完，大人再详细审理。否则——”她加重语气，目光也变得凛然，打断黄县令要截断她的动作——“若是学生就这样被大人定罪，不能参加最后一场考试，事后主考官问起来，大人恐怕无法交代。大人不会不知道，这次朝廷派来的主考官是谁吧？”
黄县令正要说“你犯了法，依法论罪，该取消考试资格。本官有何不能交代的？”然后就听见梁心铭最后那句话。
他瞪眼道：“知道又如何？”
难道那人是梁心铭的靠山？
梁心铭淡淡道：“本次主考官乃翰林院王大人。王大人是前科状元，少年才俊，聪慧过人。凡有疑难问题到他手上，没有解不开的。——听说他还帮大理寺破获了一桩积年悬案呢。那案子可悬了近二十年了。大人若是不让学生参加明天的考试，他事后必然查问，也必然会追查此案。到那时，若真凶就是学生还好；若另有其人，那大人可就……”
她没有再说下去。
后果黄县令自己会想。
黄县令在为官上很精明，一点都不蠢——能在知县附郭的情形下生存的，当然八面玲珑。他浑身激灵一下，领会了梁心铭的话意：若真凶另有其人，他这官也做到头了。
本次乡试的主考官王亨，最近在徽州城备受关注。
王亨自小在徽州长大，却不是徽州本地人，是京城人，他秀才和举人都是在徽州考的，三年前高中状元，极受靖康帝宠信，故而任命他为这次的徽州乡试主考官。

他家世显赫，年少有为，风华绝代，更难得的是至今尚未成婚，想嫁他的千金闺秀不计其数。这次到徽州，着实让徽州的名门闺秀们期盼不小，谁不想嫁他？
然世家公子少年成名，难免年少气盛。王亨傲气凌天，脾气刁钻难以捉摸。试想，地方官府把他的考生给弄走了，他要不问一声、查明真相，岂不堕了他的名头！
黄县令忽然对自己的判断失去坚持的底气，真担心事后王翰林查出另一个结果来害自己倒霉，因此萌生了退意。
梁心铭见状，再添一把火，道：“学生知道大人一心为公，然别人未必这么想，他们会说大人在乡试紧要关头羁押学生，是故意扰乱朝廷科举，甚至猜测大人有私心……”
黄县令听到这，再不敢坚持。
最后，梁心铭被当堂释放了。
当然，黄县令也没宣告她无罪，依然当她是嫌犯，并令两个差役跟着她去梁家监视，防止她夫妻逃跑。
梁心铭出了县衙，回头看着身后的衙门，神色莫名——官场险恶，今日的教训，她拽着就走。

content_en:
Liang Xinming really had nothing to say, and was speechless to the extreme about this method of trial. But she didn't show a mocking look. It doesn't matter if Magistrate Huang is ignorant, at least it will ruin her future, at worst it will ruin her life. This kind of thing is not uncommon in official circles, and you must never be careless. She forced herself to calm down and think about a way to escape.
In any case, she must leave the county office tonight and take the last exam tomorrow on time, otherwise, her previous efforts will be in vain.
She reminded: "Sir, if you put these clothes on other women, or other handsome young people, the same effect will be achieved."
Magistrate Huang was stunned, and then shouted: "Nonsense! Do other women know Tofu Xishi? Who would kill for her? Who of the other handsome young men would happen to pass by the river at that time? Even if he passed by, does it have anything to do with Tofu Xishi?"
Liang Xinming was also stunned. She didn't expect that he was not crazy or hopeless. These words made sense, and the situation was even worse for her.
She said: "Sir, the student passed by Yuliang Street in the morning. The alley runs east-west. If the student wants to go in, he must enter the alley from Yuliang Street. And this boy is guarding the east end of the alley. If the student went in, how could he not notice? How did the student come out after killing someone?"
If you don’t understand these issues, how can you convict him!
Magistrate Huang said: "So you did it brilliantly! I have to admire you. How did you commit the crime? I don't know from the facts!"
He spoke highly of Liang Xinming.
Liang Xinming was as speechless as Hui Niang. She was more astute and decisive than Hui Niang, and immediately decided to give up arguing with Magistrate Huang because it was a waste of time. If Magistrate Huang is angered again and puts her in a cell in anger, she will not be able to use it even if she has all her wits. How can she save herself?
She then said sternly: "Sir, the student is here to take the provincial examination and will have to leave tomorrow. This case is complicated and confusing. It is better for you to wait until the student has finished the examination and your Excellency will review it in detail. Otherwise -" She emphasized her tone, her eyes became stern, and interrupted Magistrate Huang. To cut off her movements - "If a student is convicted by your Majesty like this and cannot take part in the last exam, I'm afraid you won't be able to explain it when the examiner asks you afterwards. You don't know who the examiner sent by the imperial court is, right?"
Magistrate Huang was about to say, "You have violated the law. According to the law, you should be disqualified from the exam. Is there anything I can't explain?" Then he heard Liang Xinming's last words.
He glared and said, "So what if you know?"
Could that person be Liang Xinming's backer?
Liang Xinming said calmly: "The examiner this time is Mr. Wang of the Hanlin Academy. Mr. Wang is the number one scholar in the Hanlin Academy, a talented young man, and extremely intelligent. Whenever there are difficult problems that come to his hands, there are no problems that cannot be solved. - I heard that he also helped Dali Temple solve a long-standing mystery. That case has been pending for nearly twenty years. If your Excellency does not allow the student to take the exam tomorrow, he will definitely investigate and investigate the case. By then, it would be fine if the real culprit is the student; if there is someone else, then..."
She said no more.
County Magistrate Huang will think about the consequences himself.
Magistrate Huang is very shrewd in his official duties and is not stupid at all - anyone who can survive under the magistrate's attachment to Guo must be well-rounded. He felt excited all over and understood the meaning of Liang Xinming's words: If the real murderer is someone else, his official career will be over.
Wang Heng, the examiner of this provincial examination, has attracted much attention in Huizhou City recently.
Wang Heng grew up in Huizhou, but he was not a native of Huizhou, but a native of the capital. He took both the scholar and civil examination examinations in Huizhou. He was the number one scholar in high school three years ago and was highly favored by Emperor Jingkang, so he was appointed as the examiner of this Huizhou provincial examination.
He comes from a distinguished family, is young and promising, and is extremely handsome. What is even more rare is that he is not yet married, and there are countless ladies who want to marry him. This trip to Huizhou really impressed the ladies from Huizhou’s famous families.They have great expectations, who doesn’t want to marry him?
However, when a young man from an aristocratic family becomes famous, it is inevitable that he will become more energetic at a young age. Wang Heng was extremely arrogant and had a cunning and unpredictable temper. Just imagine, the local government took away his candidates. If he didn't ask and find out the truth, wouldn't his reputation be ruined?
Magistrate Huang suddenly lost the confidence to stick to his own judgment. He was really worried that Wang Hanlin would find out another result and bring bad luck to him, so he began to think about quitting.
Seeing this, Liang Xinming added fuel to the fire and said: "Students know that you are dedicated to serving the public good, but others may not think so. They will say that you are detaining students at the critical moment of the provincial examination to deliberately disrupt the imperial examination, and even speculate that you have selfish motives..."
When County Magistrate Huang heard this, he no longer dared to persist.
Finally, Liang Xinming was released in court.
Of course, County Magistrate Huang did not declare her innocent. He still regarded her as a suspect and ordered two policemen to follow her to the Liang family to monitor her and prevent her and her husband from escaping.
Liang Xinming left the county government office and looked back at the government office behind her with an incomprehensible expression - the officialdom was sinister, and she was dragging her away after today's lesson.
